lyricConnections.explanationJa: come back to haunt someone は『過去の判断が後で悩みの種になる』。ここでは断ったことを後悔しそうだと話す。

lyricConnections.lyricExpression: get you, get you, off my
lyricConnections.explanationJa: 歌では get you と mind の間に反復が入る。get someone off one's mind で『その人のことを考えるのをやめる』というまとまりになる。
live with regrets は『後悔を抱えて生きる』。ここでは勇気を出して誘い直す理由を伝える。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Is that spare seat still available for Saturday?
sentences.displayHtml: Is that spare seat still available for Saturday?

sentences.text: I think saying no is going to come back to haunt me.
sentences.displayHtml: I think saying no is going to come back to haunt me.

conversation.japanese: 土曜日の車、まだ一人乗れる？ 断ったこと、あとで後悔しそうで。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: It is, but I thought you had plans.
sentences.displayHtml: It is, but I thought you had plans.

conversation.japanese: 乗れるよ。でも予定があるって言ってなかった？ どうしたの？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Honestly, I got nervous about spending the whole weekend with you.
sentences.displayHtml: Honestly, I got nervous about spending the whole weekend with you.

sentences.text: Then I couldn't get you off my mind.
sentences.displayHtml: Then I couldn't get you off my mind.

conversation.japanese: 正直、週末ずっと君と一緒だと思ったら緊張しちゃって。それから君のことが頭から離れなくなった。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I was nervous about asking you, too.
sentences.displayHtml: I was nervous about asking you, too.

conversation.japanese: そう言ってくれればよかったのに。私も誘うの、緊張したんだよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Well, I don't want to live with regrets.
sentences.displayHtml: Well, I don't want to live with regrets.

sentences.text: Can I take you for coffee before we go?
sentences.displayHtml: Can I take you for coffee before we go?

conversation.japanese: もう後悔したくないんだ。出発前に、二人でコーヒーを飲みに行かない？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: This time, don't talk yourself out of it.
sentences.displayHtml: This time, don't talk yourself out of it.

conversation.japanese: うん、行きたい。今度はあれこれ考えてやめちゃわないでね。
